results.title: Sentiment in Software Engineering - Pure
results.content: However, while we know software engineers express sentiment and emotions, we do not know how these expressions affect the software development process. In this thesis, we study expressions of sen-timent and emotions, and specifically, we study three aspects of sentiment and emotions in software engineering: Theory, Tools, and Practice. Through studying the tools used to classify sentiment and emotions in software engineering texts, we find small differences in performance scores between contemporary machine-learning tools and recently released deep-learning tools.
